candidates.title: SeerAttention: Learning Intrinsic Sparse Attention in Your LLMs
candidates.reason: Learned block-level sparse attention with a block-sparse FlashAttention kernel; directly targets long-context prefill latency and GPU efficiency.

candidates.title: HexGen-2: Disaggregated Generative Inference of LLMs in Heterogeneous Environment
candidates.reason: Focused heterogeneous-GPU disaggregated serving system co-optimizing phase placement, parallelism, and KV communication.

candidates.title: Semantic Parallelism: Redefining Efficient MoE Inference via Model-Data Co-Scheduling
candidates.reason: MoE serving system that jointly schedules expert placement and request/token placement to reduce all-to-all communication, implemented in SGLang.

candidates.title: Utility-Driven Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
candidates.reason: vLLM-based MoE speculative-decoding framework that detects when speculation hurts and dynamically chooses draft length from measured utility.

candidates.title: POD-Attention: Unlocking Full Prefill-Decode Overlap for Faster LLM Inference
candidates.reason: GPU attention kernel explicitly co-schedules prefill and decode work on the same multiprocessors to improve utilization, throughput, and latency.
